issues.issue: [fixed: Debt Service 4,751,346 as printed p2, transfers_out 1,074,478, both $1-2 gaps in report_discrepancies] Hidden-transfer elimination is not symmetric on the page. Receipt side: Other Local Receipts 1,101,444 (p5) less Leasing Corp 1,074,477 = 26,967, which matches Other Receipts 376,689 on p2 (26,967 + non-revenue 349,244 + ESU 478). Disbursement side: Debt Service 5,825,824 (p6) less 4,751,346 on p2 = 1,074,478, and the p2 Disbursements column adds to 69,914,804, not the printed 69,914,805. The extraction used 1,074,477 on both sides, so Debt Service is 4,751,347 and the $1 is absorbed. The difference is mentioned only in notes and in this line's review text. report_discrepancies has no entry for it (it needs e.g. check 'totals', difference 1, source_page 2).
